implementation: BattleUnitView lazily creates one world-space Repair Jammer Status Icon SpriteRenderer from UI/Common/no-repair-2, positions it beside Health Label, and toggles it through SetRepairJammerActive.
BattleUnitPresenter forwards the repair-jammer visual state and BattleSceneController refreshes it from BattleSimulation.IsUnitRepairJammed during RefreshUnitViews.
LaserFenceNodeDeployedEvent exposes a read-only Position compatibility alias for Point so the existing test assembly compiles without changing event semantics.
scope: No changes were made to repair-jammer duration, damage, healing, input, or other status effects.
